_notes: API: Hydrochlorothiazide (HCT). Visible label: 'A6 R6 P9/2 HCT'.
100% standard: 2 mg/mL × 2 µL spotting volume = 4.000 µg/spot.
Solvent: Acetone (per TLCyzer Table 1).
Lane order in portrait (left→right): 60%, 90%, 80%, 90%, 100%.
REBUILT 2026-07-10: original fixture (2026-06-29) had hand-transcribed corners
predating the CSV corner-export feature, which produced a scale-mismatched
warp — real spots landed ~250px away from the recorded fractions, so
auto-detection found 0/5 spots regardless of threshold or background method.
This run re-opened the plugin interactively, re-picked the four corners
properly, and exported exact numbers via the CSV corner-export feature.
Corners recorded by the plugin are in EXIF-rotated portrait display space
(Fiji applies EXIF orientation=6 when opening the JPEG); the runner loads
the raw landscape JPEG via ImageIO (no EXIF applied). Converted portrait
(px,py) -> landscape (lx,ly) via: lx = py, ly = (1949-1) - px.
Verified: converting these corners and re-warping reproduces the exact
1487x3009 corrected-image size reported by the interactive session.
White top-hat (Option C) auto-detected all 5 spots directly at threshold 1.0
with no manual correction needed, once corners were correct.
Plate image: 41598_2022_17527_MOESM3_ESM.jpg (4096×1949 px).
Source: Hauk et al., Sci. Rep. 12, 13433 (2022), Supplementary Figure S4.
